reports.intro: The company's figures over the period chosen, compared with another. Each row opens the documents it is made of.
reports.none: No report is open to your role in this company.

errors.catalogue: The reports could not be read. Try again.
errors.gone: This report is not open to your role, or its module is switched off.
errors.refused: This report cannot be read like that: a period runs from one day to another, over a year at most.
errors.unavailable: The report could not be read. Try again.

documents.title: Documents: {{row}}
documents.more: Only the first documents are shown; the export holds them all.
documents.failed: The documents could not be read. Try again.

takings.title: Takings
takings.description: What was taken each day, by means of payment, and what was refunded.

sales-by-customer.title: Sales by customer
sales-by-customer.description: The period's revenue, customer by customer, credit notes taken off.

sales-by-product.title: Sales by item
sales-by-product.description: The quantities sold and the revenue of each item.

sales-by-family.title: Sales by family
sales-by-family.description: The revenue of each family of items, credit notes taken off.

vat-by-rate.title: VAT collected by rate
vat-by-rate.description: The base and the VAT collected on the documents issued, rate by rate: a figure to check a return against.

aged-balance.title: Aged balance
aged-balance.description: What each customer owes today, by how late their invoices are.

credit-notes-and-discounts.title: Credit notes and discounts
credit-notes-and-discounts.description: What credit notes gave back and what discounts took off, customer by customer.

withholding-suffered.title: Withholding suffered
withholding-suffered.description: What each customer withheld at source on your documents: the certificates to ask for.

stock-movements.title: Stock movements
stock-movements.description: For each item, the stock at the start, what came in and went out, and the stock at the end.

dead-stock.title: Dead stock
dead-stock.description: The items in stock that no longer sell, the quietest first.

expenses-by-category.title: Expenses by category
expenses-by-category.description: The expenses booked in the period, category by category.

expenses-by-supplier.title: Expenses by supplier
expenses-by-supplier.description: The expenses booked in the period, supplier by supplier.

activity-by-member.title: Activity by member
activity-by-member.description: What each person did in the company over the period.
